create_model_ema_v2: create a ModelEmaV2 instance to maintain exponential moving average of model weights with configurable decay rate
update_model_ema: update the EMA model state with current model parameters using exponential decay smoothing
set_model_ema: set the EMA model state to exactly match current model parameters without smoothing
configure_ema_device: configure EMA model to run on CPU or GPU device to manage memory usage during training
initialize_ema_model: initialize ModelEmaV2 with a ClassyModel, decay factor, and target device for weight averaging
